cases.description: h* = codeine||[M+H]+, precursor at its oracle m/z; one peak per support member: ion_c3h8n:C3H8N, loss_c3h7n:C3H7N, loss_c3h9n:C3H9N

cases.description: the positive spectrum of codeine||[M+H]+ without the peaks of required term loss_c3h9n; codeine||[M+H]+ still fires, because the logic has an alternative to the term
